# Reuters covers Travis Lenkner's new role at Burford as Chief Development Officer


- Law firm equity


September 16, 2024


-
-
-
-


Reuters reports on[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) 's new role as Burford's Chief Development Officer, highlighting Lenkner's focus on "opportunities related to investing in law firms, different ways of delivering legal services and legal technology, including AI," as reported by Burford.


[Click here to read the full article](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/litigation-funder-burford-eyes-law-firm-investments-ai-with-lenkner-hire-2024-09-16/) .
